export function t(key: Key) {
  return messages[pudding.locale.read()][key];
}
export function errorText(error: unknown) {
  const s = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
  return s in en
    ? t(s as Key)
    : s.includes("widget_data_conflict")
      ? t("conflict")
      : s;
}
